headline: Exploring Bridgeport: Coastal Parks and City Living
subhead: Historic waterfront green spaces, convenient transit options, and vibrant downtown arts this fall.
caption: Bridgeport offers a distinct blend of coastal scenery, historic architecture, and convenient transit. In October, seaside strolls along Seaside Park provide crisp Long Island Sound views and vibrant fall foliage, while Beardsley Park features serene wooded trails and lakefront paths. Downtown Bridgeport is home to dining options, art galleries, and live entertainment venues like the Hartford HealthCare Amphitheater. Getting around is straightforward, with direct access to Interstate 95, Route 8, the Bridgeport-Port Jefferson Ferry, and the Metro-North train station connecting easily to regional hubs. From historic neighborhoods to scenic waterfront parks, Bridgeport has diverse locations to explore this autumn.
